data.summary: Initial comprehensive system audit by e-auditor (vanguard against complexity & efficiency auditor). Verified main at 6f2e7f1 and candidate 00253fa. Measured core verification bottlenecks: audit-trust.ps1 (~4.5m) and DocstringAudit.py (~3.5m) remain primary developer cycle drags. Audited Grass/Process growth (42k+ LOC, 8 well-formedness clauses): flagged growing proof-state complexity risk. Validated Grass.Build.Cache.Key for high simplicity and minimal trusted assumptions. Confirmed agent bus reduction fix and healthy active fleet across all 16 members.
